name: Kudampuli
actions: Sold as a weight-loss supplement (hydroxycitric acid)
traditionalUses: Sour fish and vegetable curries in Kerala and coastal Karnataka
kitchenUse: A piece or two of the dried rind soaked and simmered in fish curry, like tamarind.

typicalUse.note: The Sanskrit name vrikshamla is also used for kokum (Garcinia indica); texts differ.

cautions.note: Weight-loss supplements containing garcinia have been linked to liver injury; avoid them, especially with liver disease. The rind used in cooking is a food.
Avoid the supplements in pregnancy and while breastfeeding.

interactions.effect: Supplements have been reported to interact with medicines that affect serotonin.
Supplements may interact with medicines processed by the liver.

evidence.summary: Supplements may have a small effect on weight loss, but the evidence is mixed.

sources.title: NCCIH: Garcinia Cambogia: Usefulness and Safety
